name: wickworks
description: Stateless OHLC primitives service — candlestick bars in, technical indicators and Smart-Money-Concepts objects out, over REST and MCP.

wickworks_url.title: wickworks URL
wickworks_url.description: Base URL of your running wickworks instance (WICKWORKS_URL), e.g. http://localhost:8000. wickworks is self-hosted — you run the container yourself.

wickworks_token.title: wickworks bearer token
wickworks_token.description: Bearer token (WICKWORKS_TOKEN) for a reverse proxy fronting wickworks, only if that proxy enforces auth — wickworks itself ships auth-less.
